title: Every learning attempt reaches training in the right set, with the tools it was offered (harness learning, H3)
request: The owner asked to make sure everything of the pilot is recorded for training before going to sleep, and gave a budget for Claude to draft lessons.
spec: Check what a learning attempt keeps, whether the store keeps it, and where the set builders put it; fix what would teach a model the wrong thing; draft lessons with Claude under a cap.
plan: list what a finished attempt's folder holds
check the store finds the folder and keeps every file
follow an attempt through the M5 set builder
draft lessons with the reflector purpose and check which model served it

decisions.decision: A learning attempt's planted truth is its grade
decisions.why: the set builder judged truth only for twin lanes, so a graded failure looked unjudged-but-fine

decisions.decision: An attempt marked invalid goes to the failed set with why, never counted as skill
decisions.why: a broken setup (a cut prompt, too short a budget) says nothing of the model

decisions.decision: The draft command refuses a model with no price
decisions.why: a cap counts euros; a model with no price spends without counting

change: dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (graded_attempts; a learning attempt placed by grade.json and invalid.json; an ungraded one never placed; the tools offered on its trajectory); dclab_rnd/learning/solver.py (tools.json: the schemas exactly as the loop sends them); dclab_rnd/learning/__main__.py (draft loads .env, names its model, refuses one with no price, reports the summed spend); dclab_rnd/learning/drafting.py (each challenge's spend starts at zero); tests/test_store_m5_trajectories.py, tests/test_learning_h3.py.

findings.defect: a homework that finished every stage but failed the challenge grader would be placed in the clean solver set
findings.scenario: both graded pilot homeworks copied the rules' proposal and failed on the split and a false alarm; their sessions had a holdout score and no twin verdict
findings.cause: the builder's truth came only from twin lanes' verdicts; any other workspace counted as not judged and passed to studio when scored
findings.fix: the builder reads each learning attempt's grade and invalid mark; a failed or invalid one goes to the failed set with why and its codes
findings.impact: a model trained on the clean set would have learned to copy the rules' mistakes

findings.defect: the saved tools left out the two tools the loop adds to every session
findings.scenario: tools.json held the project's 28 tools; the loop offered 30, with write_plan and finish, which ends every solved run
findings.cause: the toolbox's schemas are its scope only; the loop adds the session's own tools
findings.fix: the schemas as the loop sends them, hashed as the run records them
findings.impact: a trained model would call a tool it was never shown
findings.open: attempts kept before this change get tools.json written afterwards from the same code

findings.defect: an attempt stopped between its final stage and its grade could be placed as clean
findings.scenario: a process killed after the final stage and before the grade was written
findings.cause: with no grade the attempt looked like any unjudged session
findings.fix: a learning attempt with no grade is not judged, so never placed in studio
findings.impact: an ungraded run counted as a good one

findings.defect: the reflector the owner paid for as Claude was served by another provider's model with no price
findings.scenario: the draft command with the model: five requests went to an OpenAI model; the cap read zero spend
findings.cause: the command never loaded .env, so the provider setting was missing and the shell's OpenAI key served every tier
findings.fix: the command loads .env as the server does, names the model before spending, and refuses one with no price
findings.impact: spend on an unbudgeted provider, uncounted by the cap
findings.open: other learning commands that call a hosted model must load .env the same way

findings.defect: the reported spend was the last challenge's only
findings.scenario: four Claude answers cost about EUR 0.017; the command reported EUR 0.0042
findings.cause: the command replaced the summed total with the client's counter, which each challenge resets
findings.fix: the summed total is reported; each challenge's counter starts at zero whether it asked or not
findings.impact: spend reported four times too low

measurements.name: Claude as the reflector on five learning variants
measurements.gate: a lesson filed only after the screen
measurements.result: four failed variants answered, each with no new lesson: the two held by the rules' drafter already cover both codes
measurements.next: probe the split lesson on the local model

outcome: A learning attempt now reaches training in the set its grade says, with the tools it was offered; a broken or ungraded one never counts as skill; the reflector is served by the model the owner chose, under a cap that counts.
lessons: A set builder that knows one kind of truth treats every other run as unjudged and fine: name each source of truth.
A command that spends must load the same settings the server loads, and say which model it will use before it spends.
risks: the shell's own OpenAI key still serves any command that does not load .env
